description: Query the per-repo vector index (Voyage embeddings when configured, hash fallback otherwise). Reads the live per-push index (code_embeddings) first, falling back to the manually-reindexed chunk index (code_chunks). Returns {hits, source, indexed, indexedFiles} — `indexed: false` means the repo has never been indexed (empty hits are NOT 'no match'); `indexedFiles` is the live-index row count.
name: gluecron_semantic_search
